trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and finally the 100% completion grind for A Long Road. Keep this tracker open as you play so nothing slips through; the export button saves your progress to a file you can restore later.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI newswire

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Lucia and Jason on the Leonida coast. Follow the on-screen prompts and the mission completes in the first hour of the game. If you somehow skip past it, replay the mission from the pause menu's mission replay list — story missions can be replayed, so this is only missable in the sense that it is tied to one story beat.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI trailer 1

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 to its end. Chapters flow in order, so you cannot miss this by exploring: just keep following the story markers for Lucia and Jason. The chapter-complete screen is the trigger, so the trophy pops the moment the last Chapter 1 mission ends.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — story walkthrough

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2, the chapter where the duo's drug-running work in Vice City escalates. Complete each mission in order; side content is optional for this trophy. As with every chapter trophy, mission replay from the pause menu is your safety net if you ever need to re-run a mission.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — story walkthrough

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By this point the story opens up Vice City proper — keep pushing the gold story markers and the trophy pops at the chapter's closing mission. Use the downtime between missions to knock out nearby collectibles so the later cleanup stage is shorter.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI trailer 2

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the penultimate stretch of the story. The missions get longer and harder here, so stock up on armour and weapons at Ammu-Nation before the big set-pieces. The trophy unlocks at the final Chapter 4 mission's end screen.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — story walkthrough

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the last beat of the campaign: finish it and the gold trophy pops along with the credits. Before starting it, consider clearing any remaining story-tied trophies first — after the finale, free roam continues, but the cleanest path is to finish the story, then mop up in the open world.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 story guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named mission inside the campaign, so follow the story markers until it appears in your mission list. The trophy pops when the mission's end screen shows. If you fail it, retry from the checkpoint — failing does not lock you out.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — missions

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, one of the campaign's big heist set-pieces. Prepare before it starts: full armour, a scoped rifle, and a fast getaway car parked nearby. The heist is linear, so follow the crew's plan and the trophy unlocks at the mission's end.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 heist guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks as the story progresses — keep playing the campaign and it will appear. The mission's name hints at a family angle, so expect a character-driven sequence rather than a pure shootout; the trophy pops on completion.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — missions

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. This is a named campaign mission, so it arrives in story order — no exploration needed. Play it through to the end screen; like every story mission it can be replayed from the pause menu if you need to run it again.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — missions

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Expect a vehicle-heavy sequence: bring a fast car and watch for the airport's open sightlines. The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI trailer 2 (VCIA)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name points to a large-scale operation mission — stock armour and heavy weapons before it begins. The trophy pops at the mission's end screen.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — missions

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats screen. This is the long grind: every story mission, stranger strand, activity, race, collectible set, and hidden package counts toward it. Save it for last — by the time the other 53 trophies are done, the checklist in this tracker will show exactly what is left. Use the game's stats page to see which completion categories are still short.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 100% checklist

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, wheelies, stoppies and air time all count toward the running total shown in your stats. The fastest route is the airport runway and the long bridges out of Vice City: a fast bike, repeated jumps off ramps, and near-miss traffic runs. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so start early and it will pop naturally during the activities stage.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — stunts

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, hunting, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation and the Top Fun challenges. You do not need to win or finish them — just start each one. The in-game activities menu lists them; tick them off in this tracker as you sample each, and the trophy pops on the ninth.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI newswire (activities)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at Ammu-Nation ranges across Leonida. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed: use a rifle with a scope for distance lanes, a pistol for close lanes, and take the slow, aimed shots rather than spraying. Gold thresholds are per challenge, so replay any lane until the medal turns gold — progress saves per challenge.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — shooting range

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida. Each location has its own course: learn the gates on a practice run, then race it for real. Drones handle with momentum, so cut corners wide and brake early into tight gates. The tracker counts locations as you win them.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 drone races

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, off-road races and water races all count, but each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events. Work through the race markers on the map; a tuned sports car wins street races, a dirt bike wins off-road. Check the race menu to see which ones you have already won.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — races

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot — the docks and piers around Vice City and the Keys — and accept his challenge. Fishing is a timing minigame: wait for the bite, then reel with steady pressure and ease off when the line strains. Win the challenge and the trophy pops.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 fishing guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet in Vice City — bars and arcades around Ocean Drive have them. You only need to finish a game, not beat a high score: pick the shortest cabinet, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through to the end screen.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — arcade

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions unlock as blue markers on the map once you meet Andy in the open world — play each of his missions in order until the strand's finale. Stranger strands stay available after the story ends, so there is no rush, but finish his strand before the cleanup stage to keep the roadmap tidy.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — stranger missions

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger strand. Kenton's missions involve boats and the waterways around Leonida — keep a fast boat handy near the docks. Play his strand to its finale; the trophy pops on the last mission's end screen.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — stranger missions

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger strand. Billy's missions are bike-focused, so keep a good motorcycle in your garage. Work through his strand in order; the finale unlocks after his earlier missions are done.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — stranger missions

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each stranger has a chain of missions marked in blue: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more strangers in the open world — they appear as you explore towns like Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. A strand counts when its final mission is done.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — strangers and freaks

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger strand. Randy's missions revolve around supply runs — expect driving and delivery sequences across Leonida. Finish his chain to its last mission for the trophy.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — stranger missions

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone's chain is music and nightlife themed around Vice City's clubs — follow his blue markers through each mission until the finale. The trophy pops on the final mission's completion.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — stranger missions

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots are scenic overlooks, beaches and quiet corners — the meditation prompt appears when you stand in one. Work through them region by region: Vice City beaches, the Keys, the Grassrivers wetlands and the northern hills. Each spot only needs one meditation to count.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 meditation spots map

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret gives hunting missions in the wilderness north of Leonida — follow his strand until he marks a unique animal, then track it with a scoped rifle and take the shot cleanly. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind spawns, so save before the hunt in case the shot goes wrong.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — hunting

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden in packs across Leonida — shops, gas stations, houses and landmarks. Each set needs every card in it, so collect methodically by region and use the in-game collection menu to see which cards are still missing. Three full sets is the trophy; more sets count toward 100%.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — collectible cards map

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are marked photo and viewpoint locations across the state — open the app at a marked spot and snap it. The counter ticks up per unique location, so tour the map: beaches, landmarks, murals and viewpoints all count. Pair this with the exploration for The Goodtime State.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — WAiNK locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks — stunt jumps, races, shooting range medals, fishing catches and more all feed the same counter. Play the activities stage broadly and the counter climbs; check the challenges menu to see which categories are closest to done, then target those.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — challenges list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Easiest in the countryside: cause chaos near a quiet road, wait for the fourth star, then break line of sight and hide in the wetlands or switch cars in an alley. The trophy pops once the wanted level clears with your partner still in the vehicle.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — wanted level

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Pick three shops on one street in Vice City: rob the first, jump in the car, hit the second and third without letting the wanted level drop. Keep the getaway car close and avoid killing the shopkeepers — the wanted level must stay active through all three robberies.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 robbery guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — every car, bike, boat and aircraft you enter for the first time counts. The vehicle list in your stats shows what you have found. Tour car parks, marinas and the airport, and steal a different model each time you see one: rare spawns hide in wealthy districts and at the docks. This pairs well with On the Spot, which needs 10 vehicles registered.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming mode. Trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies in view — a gang shootout or a police chase works — and chain headshots while time is slowed. A rifle with a big magazine helps; the trophy pops when the fifth enemy drops before Combat Focus ends.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 combat guide

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get airside, steal a plane and take off without a flight plan. The runway is the obvious spot — drive onto the tarmac through a service gate, grab a small plane and lift off before security closes in. The trophy pops once you are airborne.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI trailer 2 (VCIA)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem — the description's joke is the clue. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and at the military base: reach a 4 or 5-star wanted level and one may roll in, or steal one from the base. Once you are driving it, the trophy pops for taking it for a spin.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — Rhino tank

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before any alarm. A suppressed pistol helps if a guard gets close, but the cleanest run never fires a shot. The trophy pops once you are clear with the loot.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 robbery guide

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Banks are scattered across Leonida's towns — plan one per town and bring a fast car and a crew-free escape route. Each vault robbery raises a heavy police response, so break line of sight in the back streets and switch vehicles. Five successful escapes earns the silver.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — bank robberies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Vice City: ram one to a stop or block it with your car, crack the rear doors, grab the cash and lose the cops. The truck's guards fight back, so hit it on a quiet stretch of road where you control the escape.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 robbery guide

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks discovery per area — drive, fly and sail through every named region, from Vice City and the Keys to Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park and the Grassrivers. The area counter in your stats shows what is left; finish the last few by helicopter for speed.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI map (Leonida)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked as stash houses, labs and fronts across the state — hit one per gang. Each robbery is a short combat sequence followed by a getaway, so bring armour and a fast car. The tracker lists the gangs so you can see which ones are still untouched.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — gangs of Leonida

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive in Vice Beach, order a cocktail and watch the sunset over the water. It is a quiet, one-minute moment — the trophy pops once the drink animation plays through with the ocean in view.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
Rockstar Games — GTA VI trailer 1 (Ocean Beach)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's glass front and out the other side — the Premium Deluxe-style showrooms in Vice City are the place. Any fast car works: build speed on the street outside, aim for the glass, and keep driving through the showroom floor.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — showrooms

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City. Bowling is a short minigame: aim, set power and release for the follow-through. You only need to finish a game — no strike required — so take your time on each frame and the trophy pops at the end of the game.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 bowling

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — this is a story-beat trophy tied to Lucia and Jason's partnership reaching a public high point. It unlocks during the campaign as the story hits that beat, so keep playing the story missions in order. Like the other story trophies, it pops at the end of the relevant scene.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — story walkthrough

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices — the game tracks decisions across the campaign up to a count of 500, and this trophy is tied to making them. Play the story naturally and make the choices when prompted; the trophy pops once the tracked choices reach the threshold. Different choices change later scenes, so there is no single right answer.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 choices

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then pull it off the next attempt. The simplest route is a story mission or activity you can retry: fail it once on purpose, then complete it on the retry and the trophy pops. It is a story-flavoured trophy, so it may also unlock naturally during a tough mission.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — story walkthrough

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida hides odd events, from UFO sightings over the wetlands to unexplained lights in the northern hills. Explore the map at night and visit the rumoured spots; the trophy pops when you trigger one of these strange encounters. The in-game chatter and news radio hint at where to look.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 secrets and easter eggs

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect. A slow drive past a pedestrian with a bat works — aim the swing as you pass. It counts as a drive-by only while the vehicle is moving, so keep rolling through the swing.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — drive-by

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your laundering contacts and convert them in batches. The counter tracks laundered earnings, not cash on hand, so keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs steadily toward $250,000.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 money guide

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, car mods and food all count toward the running total. The fastest route is car modification: a full tune-up on one car can cost tens of thousands. Spend naturally through the game and top up at the end with a shopping spree on Ocean Drive.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — shops

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale through the in-game property site and estate agents — buy them as they appear, starting with the cheap ones near Vice City and ending with the expensive northern properties. Each purchase needs the cash up front, so save this for after the big heist payouts.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
GameSpot GTA 6 properties

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, photograph or scan a vehicle, and register it — each distinct vehicle counts once. Scooters are everywhere in Vice City, but any vehicle works: register ten different ones and the trophy pops.
sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
IGN GTA 6 wiki — Scooter Bros app
